driver.js 1.9.0 (MIT), self-hosted so the site makes no request outside its own origin.

Every file is byte-identical to the one in the npm package named below. The tarball was fetched with `npm pack driver.js@1.9.0 --ignore-scripts` from the
npm registry into an empty folder outside the repository and extracted as data (nothing from it was run); its sha512 matched the registry's dist.integrity.
Files were copied out of the extracted tarball into this folder, unmodified. driver.js 1.9.0 was published on 2026-10-03 (pinned to it, not the newer 1.10.x line, which had three releases within a week of 2026-10-15).
To update: pack the new version the same way, replace the files, rewrite this list (`sha256sum` of every file), and run `npm test` and `npm run test:browser`.

Package (sha512 = dist.integrity from the registry):
  driver.js@1.9.0    sha512-+YWVdNVUrY1/2spszQshohWYY4soIjNBnMFS6lfmousT8igos2lmswhlqyuuNMhr+qbV0EjJ+L6i2FECPr6Ygg==   (MIT)

Files (sha256, file here <- path inside the package):
  226faa224a70df5bbe5a637c489941c004f840526359a468d7d23f8774d44a86  driver.js.mjs   <- package/dist/driver.js.mjs
  d095d440021fcf133ad46d37f18a2745fb76440f14f5208d17e203c039f765c9  driver.css      <- package/dist/driver.css
  ec3ce3a08736fefd6a03a6d5b52b0705e6919fe06de9d7bd3fb63dcfb492d76d  LICENSE         <- package/license

Why only these files: web/tour.js loads the ES module with import() on the first tour, and index.html links the stylesheet. The CommonJS and IIFE builds, the type
declarations, and the checklist and hints add-ons are not used and were left out. The module makes no network request (no fetch, XMLHttpRequest or beacon in it).
Driver.js writes a step's text with innerHTML: tour.js passes only its own constant Hebrew strings, never visitor or catalogue data.
The popover look (RTL, the site's colours in both themes) is in web/style.css, not in these files.
